checks.name: script-tests
checks.run: cd scripts && uv run --with pytest pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider test_scripts.py

checks.name: lab-tests
checks.scoped: for lab in {items}; do echo "== labs/$lab"; if [ -f labs/$lab/package.json ]; then (cd labs/$lab && npm ci --silent && npm test --silent) || exit 1; else (cd labs/$lab && uv run --frozen pytest -q) || exit 1; fi; done
checks.run: for lab in $(ls labs); do echo "== labs/$lab"; if [ -f labs/$lab/package.json ]; then (cd labs/$lab && npm ci --silent && npm test --silent) || exit 1; else (cd labs/$lab && uv run --frozen pytest -q) || exit 1; fi; done
covers: for lab in $(LABS); do echo "== $$lab"; if [ -f $$lab/package.json ]; then (cd $$lab && npm ci --silent && npm test --silent) || exit 1; else (cd $$lab && uv run --frozen pytest -q) || exit 1; fi; done
